about_the_game:
🔥 A challenging dark fantasy hack & slash where players must cleanse a cursed castle, battle through an enchanted forest, and descend into the underworld to eradicate the undead hordes.

⚔️ Brutal and strategic combat: Master melee attacks, bow skills, and magic to take on increasingly deadly enemies.

🏰 Explore a decaying world: From the ruins of a besieged castle to the cursed dark forests and the depths of the underworld, each environment presents unique challenges.

💀 Relentless enemies: Dodge swift specters, clash with armored warriors, evade deadly traps set by archers, and withstand the dark magic of necromancers.

🔥 Colossal bosses: Face the Lord of Fire, who scorches everything in his path, and the Necromancer, who raises legions of the dead.

🛡️ Adapt your strategy: Each level shifts the gameplay, forcing you to use new tactics to survive and purge the kingdom of darkness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: intel core i5-4670K / AMD FX8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960(2048MB) /AMD Radeon RX 470(2048MB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: intel core i7-6700k / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 (2048 MB) / Radeon R9 Fury (4096 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: A challenging dark fantasy hack & slash where players must defend humanity’s last bastion against hordes of the undead, battling through enchanted forests and descending into the underworld.
